title: IOT-EE platform service configuration (draft)
description: Draft JSON Schema for a services/* module's cfg.yaml (ADR 0012 Decision 3). Lives under contracts/ (ADR 0013): a shared contract artifact, source only -- every service validates its own cfg.yaml against this same file directly, never through a shared runtime library. Intentionally minimal: only the fields every service is already expected to have (tenant scoping mode, fixed by ADR 0016, and a correlation-id policy toggle). NOT the final schema -- see the Non-goals note in services/identity/README.md. Extend this file, in its own reviewed change, as real configuration surface is added.

service_name.description: Matches this service's Maven artifactId, e.g. "iotee-service-identity".

tenant_mode.description: How this service scopes tenant-owned data. "pooled-rls" is the only accepted mode (ADR 0016 Decisions 1-2): every tenant-owned row carries a non-null tenant_id, isolation is enforced first by the service's ABAC tenant check and second by PostgreSQL Row-Level Security with ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and SET LOCAL app.tenant_id per transaction. Schema-per-tenant was rejected by ADR 0016; any other mode requires a new ADR, not an edit here.

correlation_id.description: Optional overrides for the default X-Correlation-ID behavior (ADR 0012 Decision 5). Omit entirely to accept the default: this service treats every inbound request as a trust boundary and always mints a fresh ID.

trust_boundary.description: Defaults to true. Set to false ONLY for a service with no APISIX edge in front of it that must propagate an upstream-platform-internal correlation ID instead of minting a new one -- see each service's own CorrelationIdContext Javadoc for why this is not the default.
